_comment: GENERATED by scripts/gen-bill-docs.mjs — do not edit by hand. One entry per /b/<sitting>/<number> document: sitting, number, chamber, stored title, and the issues it is mapped to, each with the effect line stored for that pair where one is. Read by netlify/lib/share-target.ts (the body the edge writes) and scripts/gen-sitemap.mjs (the bill rows it lists). No score, no direction, no scraped text.
